brief:
**BLUF:** Tazewell unveiled a statue honoring native son and Baseball Hall of Famer Billy Wagner on Main Street Saturday afternoon. A Tazewell County Drug and Violent Crimes Task Force operation with Bluefield PD seized over 600 grams of illicit cannabis in Bluefield, Va., on Oct. 8 with charges pending. A school bus crash in North Tazewell on Oct. 12 injured one student and one driver; the at-fault driver was charged with reckless driving. No active NWS alerts or major incidents reported in the core area today.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/18/tazewell-unveils-main-street-statue-honoring-hall-fame-closer-billy-wagner/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Tazewell County / Bluefield VA:** On Oct. 8, the Tazewell County Drug and Violent Crimes Task Force and Bluefield Police Department executed a search warrant at the Tobacco Hut and Vape in Bluefield, Va., seizing 606.75 grams of illicit cannabis. Investigation into unlawful sales continues; charges pending.[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/15/authorities-seize-over-pound-illicit-cannabis-bluefield/)

**Mercer County WV (Bluefield area):** Christopher J. Loucks, 48, of Bluefield, was charged with one count of strangulation and one count of child abuse by parent/guardian causing bodily injury (felonies), plus two counts of misdemeanor domestic battery after an Oct. 3 domestic disturbance on Willow Street. He is held at Southern Regional Jail on $15,000 bond.[[3]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/14/felony-charges-lodged-after-domestic-altercation/)

William Heath Jr. was arrested in Mercer County after hundreds of alleged child pornography images were found on his phone following a report on Oct. 3; warrants issued for possession/distribution charges under WV code. Phone sent for forensic analysis.[[4]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/man-arrested-in-mercer-county-after-child-pornography-was-allegedly-found-on-his-cell-phone/amp/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours meeting priority thresholds.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
**Tazewell County:** Tazewell County Public Schools confirmed a three-vehicle crash involving TCPS Bus 71 on Oct. 12 at approximately 3:51 p.m. in North Tazewell. The bus was stopped; a third vehicle struck a stopped car, which hit the bus. One student and the driver of the stopped car suffered non-life-threatening injuries and were transported to a local hospital. All other students were evaluated by EMS and returned home. The at-fault driver was charged with reckless driving. Town of Tazewell Fire/EMS and Virginia State Police responded.[[5]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/12/two-injured-after-tazewell-county-school-bus-crash/)

Tazewell County’s new countywide fire department began operations Oct. 15 after Board of Supervisors approval of the firefighter roster; stations remain in place with unified training.[[6]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/07/tazewell-county-approves-firefighter-list-new-countywide-department/)

**Region:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
No active NWS alerts for the core area. Bluefield, WV, recorded a high of 48°F and low of 34°F on Oct. 17 with 0.09 inches of precipitation.[[7]](https://marine.weather.gov/product.php?site=OTX&issuedby=BLF&product=CLI&format=CI&version=1&glossary=1)

**Region:** Nothing significant reported on I-77, I-81, or other major routes in the last 24 hours.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Tazewell County / Town of Tazewell:** Town council discussed and agreed to adjust background check protocols for events following community concerns about safety in children’s spaces (meeting around Oct. 14).[[8]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/14/community-member-seeks-answers-regarding-background-checks-tazewell-events/)

**Region:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Tazewell, VA:** The Billy Wagner Park Committee unveiled a statue of the Tazewell native and National Baseball Hall of Famer on Main Street on Oct. 17. Wagner attended and spoke, crediting local coaches and the 1986 Tazewell Bulldogs. The project honors his MLB career and local roots.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/18/tazewell-unveils-main-street-statue-honoring-hall-fame-closer-billy-wagner/)

Bluefield State University held a United Nations Day event with international food on Oct. 17.[[9]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/bluefield-trunk-or-treat-event/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported.

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Tazewell County Chamber events and library programs scheduled through Oct. 24 (e.g., watercolor class Oct. 20 in Bluefield, Trunk or Treat in Richlands Oct. 22).[[10]](https://www.tazewellchamber.com/events/)
- Ongoing fundraising for Billy Wagner Park bricks and related events. No major weather or road hazards forecast.
